Chicken, Broccoli & Rice Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, April 23, 2010 - 1:29am

Ingredients




1 lg. pkg. chicken breast
1 onion, diced
2 cups rice
2 pkg. chopped broccoli
1 can cream of chicken
1/2 stick butter
1/2 bell pepper
2 sticks celery
5 cups chicken broth
1 can cream of mushroom
1 jar (8 oz.) jalapeno Cheez Whiz

Preparation

1 Salt, boil and debone the chicken breast. Chop and saute the bell pepper, onion and celery in butter. Cook rice in broth. Drain broccoli. Mix all ingredients. Stir. Bake in casserole dish for 30-40 minutes at 350 degrees. Top with grated cheese.
